sections.title: 1. Define
sections.body: Name the resource, audience, placement and question. Plan recruitment, consent, sample and decision criteria.

sections.title: 2. Ask
sections.body: Use recommendation, memorability and open feedback. Test comprehension separately.

sections.title: 3. Diagnose
sections.body: Rate memorable, engaging, respectful, clear and relevant. Pretest the questions.

sections.title: 4. Follow up
sections.body: Ask for unprompted recall, then knowledge and optional follow-through. Report response counts.

sections.title: 5. Calculate
sections.body: NPS = % rating 9–10 minus % rating 0–6. Include 7–8 in the denominator; report missing answers.

sections.title: 6. Decide
sections.body: Report distributions, uncertainty and negative findings. Fix errors, retest, and avoid unsupported causal claims.
